integrity: A complete symbolic proof accompanies finite reproducibility checks; finite checks do not replace quantification over all n and p. No claim of independent certification or absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime p and the standard exponent-p Heisenberg group of order p^(2n+1), with n>=2; labeled operators rather than equivalence orbits. Potential implicit antecedents from Lie operator theory remain a priority risk.
title: All group Rota–Baxter operators on higher finite Heisenberg groups
